overview.title: Aithera Prototype Guide
overview.description: Stakeholder index of every Aithera prototype, riff and working doc, grouped by prototype with a status tag and one-line description for each.

..title: Adaptive Learning (App)
..description: Mobile-first adaptive-learning PWA with Home, Courses, Coach Vic, Practice, and Reference tabs; mastery advances from practice outcomes.

bbp-admin.title: Learning Engine: Admin (Assign, Settings, Preview, Reporting)
bbp-admin.description: Admin experience for adaptive courses: assign to org groups with inherited settings, preview a learner’s path, and report on outcomes, pacing and each learner’s journey across courses.

le-launch.title: Learning Engine: Assign a Course (Prototype Launcher)
le-launch.description: Settings-and-assignment riff that starts the live Learning Engine prototype: four checkout-style steps (course, learner, how it adapts, testing options) and a setup link for testers.

admin-preview.title: Learning Engine: Admin Preview (Design / Play)
admin-preview.description: Opened from Admin preview in either assign flow: every Contain the Sharp (or Hazing) screen as a zoomable slide sorter with K/F/D labels, relit per learner answers and sector; click any slide to play it live.

lesson-presentation/clara/hazing.html.title: CLARA: Hazing (Higher Ed), Module 5
lesson-presentation/clara/hazing.html.description: Sharps-style adaptive module for Report Hazing: pre-check routes test-out, test-up and remedial chapters; Athletes and Greek Life audiences; placeholder video and audio.

proven.title: PROVEN — Future-State Homepage
proven.description: Editorial landing page for Vector's PROVEN positioning, with a sticky glass nav over dark/light sections and a demo-request form.

scenario-marshall.html.title: Scenario Simulator — Marshall
scenario-marshall.html.description: Chat-based 'Marshall Scenario' simulator where learners type free-text replies that are tier-shaded and scored against a framework.

immersive.html.title: Immersive Panorama
immersive.html.description: Fullscreen 360° panorama viewer with drag-to-look navigation, a scene-briefing overlay, and a floating scene badge and controls.

voice-scene.html.title: Voice Observation — Highway Spill
voice-scene.html.description: Voice-driven 360° tanker-rollover scene where the learner pans around and records hazard observations by mic into a transcript.

staging.html.title: Fireground Staging — 2-Alarm
staging.html.description: Leaflet-map staging drill for a 2-alarm fire where engines, ladders, and hydrants drag onto the map from a palette.

lesson-presentation.title: All Experiments
lesson-presentation.description: Index of lesson-presentation experiments — Layered Learning, Video Reflection, Basic Interactions, and Custom Code. The Scenario Simulator is now its own area.

resources/learning-phases.html.title: The Eight Learning Phases
resources/learning-phases.html.description: Print-style serif reference walking through the eight learning phases, from identifying outcomes to credentialing and proving impact.

scenario-simulator.title: Scenario Simulator
scenario-simulator.description: The example interactions the dev team builds V1 against, plus the editor an LXD uses to author the JSON their engine loads.

scenario-simulator/scenario-editor.title: Scenario Editor
scenario-simulator/scenario-editor.description: Author a scenario from a template or import an existing .lo.json, edit every field with live guardrails, then export the file to upload back.

lesson-presentation/scenario-coach-progr.title: Coach Progress Strip — Concept (mock)
lesson-presentation/scenario-coach-progr.description: POC: a minimal progress strip over the AI-coach chat so coach-led prompts feel structured and tracked, not endless. Self-contained scripted Marshall demo.

scenario-simulator/archive/scenario-live.title: Coach Progress Strip — Live Player Fork
scenario-simulator/archive/scenario-live.description: The same strip wired into the real guided-arc player, inside the coach panel, advancing on live phase changes. Product declined; kept as a proof-of-concept.
